title: AgenticOperatingPatterns
description: Clustered KEEP/BAN operating patterns distilled into Swarm Delivery Law (ADR-0711 Amendment C / operating-patterns catalog). Not paraphrases of the source archive. Load-bearing entries carry rules-with-why fields (achieves/origin/rule/ensure/overturn_when).

_meta.corpus: ADR-0711 Amendment C operating-patterns catalog (archive distillation 000-136)
_meta.acceptance_note: Promoted Accepted on #1644 so Claim rename/classifier refusal criteria match ADR-0711 Amendment B/C + END-STATE-POLICY (Proposed carries no implement authority).

rule_shape.achieves: what the rule protects / makes true
rule_shape.origin: failure or pressure that created the rule
rule_shape.rule: the mechanism (RFC-2119 MUST/MUST NOT where applicable)
rule_shape.ensure: how we prove it still holds (gate, receipt, test, review)
rule_shape.overturn_when: first-principles conditions under which replacing it is legal (challenge → OVERRULE → version bump)
rule_shape.note: Rules are hypotheses, not folklore. Rules without why train obedience; rules with why train judgment.

keep.achieves: Parallelism scales without unbounded worktree/cache/index mass.
keep.origin: Fleet fan-out sized by lane count produced replicated-state thrash.
keep.rule: Design cleanup/ownership of replicated state before scaling parallelism; size by replicated mass, not lane count.
keep.ensure: Window receipts record hot-set + worktree inventory; merge_windows.hot_set_max caps restackable tips.
keep.overturn_when: A measured constant-work design removes replicated mass as the binding constraint.

keep.achieves: Automation and babysit cannot mint merge/APPROVE authority from density of observation.
keep.origin: Observation packets and green CI were treated as land license.
keep.rule: Dense observation does not grant intervene/APPROVE/own rights; automation stops at authority edge.
keep.ensure: Claim/Land refuse observation-as-APPROVE; dual-critic + oya-ci-required remain admission predicates.
keep.overturn_when: A new admission predicate is dual-emitted and founder-flipped with explicit OVERRULE receipt.

keep.achieves: Empty space stays empty; agents do not invent work for optics.
keep.origin: Coverage-optics deepen and filler quotas into verified-empty roots.
keep.rule: Verified-empty, honest undecided, and precise halt are completed ops — record them; do not invent work to fill silence.
keep.ensure: Judgment rows may be verified-empty; scaffold-idle requires written reason.
keep.overturn_when: A named consumer + acceptance criteria appear for previously empty space.

keep.achieves: Done claims are HEAD-keyed and multi-signal; stale tips cannot launder as current proof.
keep.origin: Sticky prior greens and narrative done without receipts.
keep.rule: HEAD-keyed receipts; multi-signal done (CI + review + mergeState + live surface); new HEAD → new evidence; quarantine invalid receipts.
keep.ensure: Claim packet + babysit window receipts cite tip SHA; re-verify at moment of action.
keep.overturn_when: Admission predicates change via dual-emit + founder flip with doctrine bump.

keep.achieves: Missing inputs fail closed with a named next action.
keep.origin: Silent success on blocked inputs and rubber-stamp thread resolve.
keep.rule: Missing inputs/identity → fail closed; blockers named by gate with next action; silence only when proven idle.
keep.ensure: Claim/Land + gates REFUSE on missing packet/waiver/hub exclusivity.
keep.overturn_when: A gate proves a safe default-open path under zero-trust review.

keep.achieves: One writer queue per subsystem; planner ≠ implementer; adversarial review.
keep.origin: Same-subsystem thrash across many tips; self-approve loops.
keep.rule: Batch same-subsystem work into one lane; planner ≠ implementer; one implementer + adversarial reviewers; accelerate on owner-hook, brake on verified empty.
keep.ensure: Envelope sole-owner + role tags on dispatches; critic separate from implementer.
keep.overturn_when: A different role topology is OVERRULEd with measured blast-radius evidence.

keep.achieves: Shared-object/index.lock contention does not cause blind lock deletion.
keep.origin: Agents deleted index.lock and corrupted shared WD state.
keep.rule: On index.lock / shared-object contention: check owning pid, retry idempotent — never blind-delete the lock.
keep.ensure: Worker git allowlist denies destructive unlock; shim/toolguard refuse.
keep.overturn_when: Worktree isolation makes shared locks impossible and shim enforcement proves it.

keep.achieves: Green admits the next gate only; same-author APPROVE banned.
keep.origin: Merge ego after green; observation density as scoreboard.
keep.rule: Green admits the next gate only, not departure; same-author APPROVE banned; re-verify at moment of action.
keep.ensure: Branch protection + Tide author≠reviewer floor; Land re-checks tip.
keep.overturn_when: A stronger multi-party admission model replaces current predicates with dual-emit evidence.

keep.achieves: Build≠publish; post-merge until live surface is green.
keep.origin: Wrapper noise treated as artifact fail; deploy without live smoke.
keep.rule: Public/live smoke after deploy; build ≠ publish; wrapper noise ≠ artifact fail; post-merge until live surface is green.
keep.ensure: Post-merge product-completion packet requires live/observability evidence.
keep.overturn_when: A different live-proof contract is accepted with SLO-backed ensure path.

keep.achieves: Forever names follow taxonomy; labels act as switches not decoration.
keep.origin: Brand/opaque/ADR-in-title durable names and one-off bespoke renames.
keep.rule: Sharp labels as action switches; forever names follow specs/naming-taxonomy.json.
keep.ensure: naming_sweep cites kind + grammar_compliant; taxonomy overturned_patterns for indefensible shapes.
keep.overturn_when: Taxonomy kinds/grammar are OVERRULEd with 16-lens judgment_status=done.

keep.achieves: Stable ADR citation paths without mass-rename churn; indexes carry navigation.
keep.origin: Pattern-First draft proposed topic-only ADR paths; challenged mass rename as taxonomy theater (adr-rename-overturn).
keep.rule: Keep docs/decisions/ADR-NNNN-<topic>.md forever; indexes/frontmatter carry nav; MUST NOT mass-rename ADR files for optics.
keep.ensure: specs/naming-taxonomy.json#kinds.decision-record + overturned_patterns OP-adr-numbered-decision-paths verdict=keep; ADR-0711 Amendment E; naming_sweep rows match.
keep.overturn_when: A measured findability failure proves NNNN-topic harmful AND a batched judged rename plan clears 16-lens with zero dual-truth during cutover.

keep.achieves: Early buck2 [check] feedback on ≤hot_set_max integ stations without worker-lane builds or cargo revival.
keep.origin: 16-lens northstar R9; founder 2026-05-29 no-cargo; false parallelism paid full CI per unit.
keep.rule: Run check-daemon on hot-set integ stations (≤ merge_windows.hot_set_max); main checkout remains orchestrator+daemon; LSP/rust-analyzer read-only ≠ build ≠ merge authority.
keep.ensure: envelopes#daemon_hotset + #merge_windows; process-kit harness under ci/facade/harness/daemon-hotset.v1.json on integ/ci; self-check cites hot_set_max.
keep.overturn_when: envelopes#merge_windows.hot_set_max changes same-wave OR blessed local type-check leaves buck2 [check] OR founder authorizes different warm-daemon topology.

keep.achieves: Advisory channels cannot write main checkout or mint merge authority; hotfix/* is not a prose-only trunk escape.
keep.origin: 16-lens northstar R10; optional omx/omc/gjc/grok used as default drivers / main-checkout writers.
keep.rule: Advisory omx/omc/gjc/grok MUST run in scratch worktrees/clones and MUST NOT write the main checkout; hotfix/* requires founder ack or incident evidence (Phase B gate).
keep.ensure: envelopes#perimeter; ci/facade/harness/perimeter.v1.json on integ/ci; Claim/Land refuse hotfix without evidence schema when Phase B live.
keep.overturn_when: Founder retires advisory channels OR Phase B hotfix evidence schema is amended OR worktree topology (ADR-0711 D-5) is OVERRULEd.

ban.achieves: Prevents activity theater filling verified-empty space.
ban.rule: Inventing work into verified empty; activity theater; filler quotas; observing = intervening.
ban.overturn_when: Named consumer + acceptance criteria exist for the previously empty space.

ban.achieves: Single enumeration SSOT; yesterday's green cannot prove today's tip.
ban.origin: Prose re-lists + sticky prior merge greens across new HEAD.
ban.rule: Dual-home / dual-truth; carrying yesterday’s green as today’s proof; sticky prior merge-admission green across new HEAD.
ban.overturn_when: N/A as a ban class — replace only by proving a single new SSOT with dual-emit cutover.

ban.achieves: One blessed build path; no shared-WD stash/reset chaos.
ban.origin: Cargo revival + shared WD agent collisions.
ban.rule: Cargo/second-build-path revival; slow commands in lanes; shared WD stash/reset chaos; PID kill without identity.
ban.ensure: no-cargo-enforcer + toolguard; worktree-per-lane; check-daemon buck2 [check] only.
ban.overturn_when: Founder authorizes a different blessed local type-check with no second path.

ban.achieves: Role-first forever names; ADR numbers stay citation ids not job-title path keys for CI.
ban.origin: oya-/cloud- prefixes and ADR-in-job-title durable names.
ban.rule: Leading oya-*/cloud-*/opaque/ADR-in-job-title durable names (Amendment B Pattern-First). Note: ADR file paths keep ADR-NNNN-<topic> (Amendment E OVERRULE) — this ban targets CI job titles and brand prefixes, not decision-record filenames.

ban.achieves: Blocked inputs cannot report success; observation density ≠ scoreboard.
ban.origin: Rubber-stamp thread resolve and merge ego after green.
ban.rule: Silent success on blocked inputs; rubber-stamp thread resolve; merge ego after green; observation-density scoreboards.
ban.ensure: Fail-closed Claim + Tide author≠reviewer; window receipts.
ban.overturn_when: Admission predicates change with explicit OVERRULE and ensure path.

ban.origin: Proposed topic-only mass rename of ADR-NNNN-* paths without findability failure evidence.
ban.rule: Mass-rename ADR files for optics; treating ADR-NNNN path segment as indefensible when indexes already carry nav.
ban.ensure: OP-adr-numbered-decision-paths verdict=keep; Amendment E; naming_sweep forever=NNNN-topic.

overrules.note: Distill corpus is operating-pattern evidence, not naming authority. Brand/ADR-in-title bans stand. Legacy protection pin is dual-emit cutover only.
adr-rename-overturn: forever-correct is NNNN-topic + indexes — not churn later, not churn now. Chesterton: numbered paths are citation-stable; mass rename is high fan-in theater.
